class.name: OcgMessagePrintertoreport
class.brief_description: Implementation of a message printer associated with Message_Report Send will create a new alert of the report. If string is sent, an alert is created by Eol only. The alerts are sent into set report or default report of Message.
class.description: ! Implementation of a message printer associated with Message_Report ! Send will create a new alert of the report. If string is sent, an alert is created by Eol only. ! The alerts are sent into set report or default report of Message.

method.name: default
method.description: Create printer for redirecting messages into report.

method.name: Report
method.description: Returns the current or default report

method.name: SendStringStream
method.description: Send a string message with specified trace level. Stream is converted to string value. Default implementation calls first method Send().

method.name: SendObject
method.description: Send a string message with specified trace level. The object is converted to string in format: <object kind> : <object pointer>. The parameter theToPutEol specified whether end-of-line should be added to the end of the message. Default implementation calls first method Send().
